english.title: Driver failing to make duplicate entry on drivers record book

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: DRIVERS HOURS GOODS VEHICLES KEEPING OF RECORDS REGULATIONS 1987

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a driver making an entry in a weekly record sheet, failed to ensure that the entry was simultaneously reproduced on the duplicate of that sheet
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 7(5) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987 and section 98(4) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who was employed by **(..SPECIFY EMPLOYER..) as a driver of a goods vehicle, made an entry in a weekly record sheet without ensuring that a copy was simultaneously reproduced on the duplicate of that sheet.
